# Kenney Watercraft Kit

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/watercraft-kit
- Version: 2.1
- Downloaded: 2026-09-10
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0 Universal)
- Original archive: `kenney_watercraft-pack.zip`

This directory contains a curated GLB subset used by the AmpliWorld waterfront scene. The original `License.txt` is preserved alongside the models. The `Textures/colormap.png` file is retained at the relative path referenced by the GLBs.

Included models:

- `boat-fishing-small.glb`
- `boat-sail-a.glb`
- `boat-speed-a.glb`
- `boat-speed-f.glb`
- `boat-tug-a.glb`
- `buoy.glb`
- `ship-cargo-a.glb`
- `ship-large.glb`
- `ship-ocean-liner-small.glb`
- `ship-ocean-liner.glb`
